categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches label 'Tests', modifies fuzz harness utilities in 'src/test/fuzz/util/rpc.{cpp,h}', and creates a new fuzz harness
categories.rationale: Extracts shared fuzz harness utility code and introduces fuzzing for RPC endpoints that previously had zero OSS-Fuzz coverage. While fuzzing wallet RPCs in isolation does not touch consensus or P2P code paths, expanding fuzz harness coverage to unexercised parameter parsing paths is worthwhile test infrastructure work.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Adds a wallet-specific fuzz harness in 'src/wallet/test/fuzz/rpc.cpp' targeting wallet RPC methods
categories.rationale: Addresses the lack of fuzz testing for wallet RPC parameter parsing and input validation. While isolated fuzzing without full state limits coverage of stateful wallet operations, hardening wallet RPC entry points against malformed inputs provides genuine stability value.
